clips.title: The story
paras: In Camp Narache, Verdant Note calls young tauren druids to begin their training. Sent for Gart Mistrunner, it guides them toward the rites of the Earthmother.

Young tauren with a gift for nature receive Verdant Note soon after their trials begin in the Red Cloud Mesa. A messenger carries Gart Mistrunner's brief summons to Camp Narache, where the initiate must report to the mentor. Restless spirits and shifting elements trouble Mulgore, and the elders need new druids trained quickly.

Gart Mistrunner teaches initiates to commune with nature. He warns that night elves share a bond with the wild but keep their distance from tauren, guarded by ancient pride. Tauren druidism centers on reverence for the Earthmother. Initiates learn to hear the land's restless ancestral voices and serve as her living instruments.
